field.value: <<bb>>Receiving Inspection <</bb>> <<nl/>><<nl/>><<nl/>><<nl/>><<nl/>>Review the shipping documents upon receiving the SLAM shipment for CU and Non Cu staging of the parts. Only open the Cu parts in the Cu area and the Non Cu parts in the Non Cu area. Inspect the lid for damage or missing parts. Also inspect the transit case for any signs of damage. (Note that RH and LH lids will have different cases. Don''t forget to label the case with the work order#.) Damaged or missing cases will need to be repaired or replaced. Report any issues to the production manager.
